description: This PHP source file manages the admin accounts page of an e-commerce application. It handles session management for admin authentication, allows deletion of admin accounts, and displays a list of existing admin accounts with options to delete or update them.

methods.name: delete_admins
methods.description: Prepares and executes a statement to delete an admin record from the database based on provided ID.

methods.name: select_accounts
methods.description: Fetches all admin accounts from the database to display on the page.
